text: ok and so this is what il say before we just end up reworking it but i have expressed the problem with the app locking up is a thing inside of this color dragging map, but you also say its inside of a camera postion in places in the app, and thats where it becomes a bit confusing because all the cameras, as far as im concerend, are perfectly fine, they dont cause this. or am i missing something
resolution: Clarified the reported color-drag lockup versus smooth camera behavior with a side-by-side source trace. The camera path is not an AppFrame/root-state path: it mutates a small IsoPose, sends eight numeric camera values to the host, and hot-writes only that tiny pose, so smooth observed behavior is consistent. The color map calls root setState on every mouse move, causing whole AppFrame re-render/persist; in model paint that color then reconciles into ModelView brush state, whose onToolState echoes a second root update/persist and whose own ToolTwig also writes. ColorLibraryPanel also recomputes all derived color collections per sample. Corrected the classification: camera persistence is a low-cost cadence/architecture smell, not the demonstrated lockup and not part of the color performance fix. No files changed.
